chat.auto_scroll_description: Follow streaming messages while you are at the bottom of the conversation.
chat.spellcheck_description: Show operating-system spelling suggestions in the Chat composer.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: A complete list of Desktop application commands and contextual actions. Standard buttons, forms, and selection controls follow platform keyboard conventions and are not repeated here.
shortcuts.toggle_sidebar_description: Toggles the main sidebar from any page.
shortcuts.toggle_baybar: Show or hide the right panel
shortcuts.toggle_baybar_description: Toggles the right panel from any page. Collapsing it does not close the tabs you have open.
shortcuts.focus_chat_input_description: Moves keyboard focus to the Chat input on the current page. Does nothing when no input is available.
shortcuts.open_settings_description: Opens the Account section in Settings.
shortcuts.open_command_palette_description: Opens global command search and execution.
shortcuts.new_conversation_description: Creates a conversation for the current Group or Agent and moves keyboard focus to its input. A Workspace must be selected.
shortcuts.close_settings_description: Returns to the location used before opening Settings. Available only in Settings.
shortcuts.primary_views_description: Numbers follow the visible order of the primary navigation rail.
shortcuts.open_chat_description: Switches to Chat, the first primary destination.
shortcuts.open_workspace_description: Switches to Workspace, the second primary destination.
shortcuts.open_powers_description: Switches to Powers, the third primary destination.
shortcuts.open_power_view_description: Opens primary destinations 4 through 9 in sidebar order. Applies only to Powers that provide both a sidebar and a main view.
shortcuts.enter_description: Sends only when the content is one paragraph containing plain text only. Multiple paragraphs, lists, attachments, references, or hard breaks insert a new paragraph instead.
shortcuts.hard_break_description: Always starts a new line within the current paragraph without submitting.
shortcuts.submit_description: Sends while idle with an empty queue; adds to the queue while running or when a queue already exists.
shortcuts.queue_paused_description: Creates the queue when needed, then inserts a paused message that will not send automatically.
shortcuts.steer_description: Bypasses the existing queue and submits immediately without changing other queued messages.
shortcuts.contextual_actions_description: These keys work only while the corresponding editor or menu has focus.
shortcuts.generate_draft: Generate an Agent or Group draft
shortcuts.generate_draft_description: Starts AI generation from the description step when creating an Agent or Group.
shortcuts.save_queue_edit_description: Saves changes while editing a plain-text message in the outgoing queue.
shortcuts.cancel_edit_description: Discards the current edit of a queued message or historical user message.
shortcuts.navigate_suggestions_description: Moves the active option cyclically in the Slash command menu.
shortcuts.accept_suggestion_description: Accepts the active Slash command, or the first item in a member or file suggestion list.

network.title: Network proxy
network.description: Applies to Desktop and every Power/Agent network request. Inherits the operating system proxy when disabled.
network.enabled_description: Set an explicit proxy address that takes priority over the system proxy. Enabled channels reconnect after saving.
